name: 島全体の完成予想・未選定
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one exquisitely charming real-time stylized 3D game render: a full grown Sansu island with a substantial fairy-tale sense of place. This is a provisional whole-world visual goal, not an approved gameplay specification. ONE single landscape scene, no panels, text, UI, labels, symbols, borders.
Reference roles: image1 existing bright initial game island screenshot = clean blue sea, sunny daylight, rounded toy 3D, small cottage with colorful patchwork roof and blue door. Image2 crowded mature screenshot = diagnosed failure; KEEP home and resident vocabulary but TRANSFORM scattered independent tiny props and flat rectangular mat into distinctive GROWN PLACES. Do not copy its huge free background branch or clutter. Image3 actual Pokomoko original portrait = exact existing cream-left/blue-right face, cream muzzle, black bead eyes, black spotted left round ear, pink spotted right round ear, colorful patchwork body and red scarf. Preserve this identity and proportions, depict a few SMALL residents naturally inhabiting the place; don't replace with generic big-eyed dolls.
Composition: fixed orthographic 3/4 game camera, entire cohesive coastal island visible with sea margin, horizontal landscape, readable as three primary inhabited districts, a generously open front, naturally uneven softly rounded shoreline and two modest ground levels. Rich layered depth; clear paths and resident access; no floating island, no sky horizon scene, no UI. Cottage scale and contrast make the mature plants feel extraordinary. Broad quiet color masses instead of catalog rows of decorations.
The visual heart at rear-left: a grove of planted trees has grown into a fantastic, massive living tree court. SIX TO EIGHT distinct rooted trunks share sweeping upper boughs and a sculptural tiered canopy about three to four cottage heights. A great sunny opening beneath invites walking through; branches grow into TWO wide asymmetrical arches continuing diagonally toward the middle of the island. Trunks visibly emerge from owned planted ground, no single free giant tree backdrop. Smooth rounded foliage with gently varied lobes, tactile subtly painted thick wood and soft contact shadows, tree roots are gentle grounding masses, never tentacles.
Middle-right: planted flowering trees have grown into an airy open crescent gathering court, connected crowns with ivory/coral flowers that read as one larger PLACE; its middle is clear and sunlit. A blue shallow stream curves between the two plant districts, with coherent banks, visible continuous flow and ONE modest rounded timber bridge crossing where the main walking route passes. Stream follows believable island ground slopes and meets the sea; no unsupported waterfall or decorative bowls posing as stream.
Front-right: three familiar small rounded cottages with cream walls and blue/coral/yellow patchwork roof sections share a sunny common courtyard and one connected approach to the bridge. Existing original cottage remains recognizable, and the little colorful fabric residents are clearly much smaller than the houses. A resident rests in the big tree shade, one walks the bridge, one stands in the open courtyard. Front-left shoreline remains uncluttered, sandy rim with a few grouped rocks and grassy texture, places retain breathing room. Tiny plant patches are grouped around the main rooted places; no rows of benches, lamps, fountains, picnic props, signs, statues, balloons or trinkets.
Rendering: extraordinary beautiful polished rounded THREE-DIMENSIONAL game art, playful organic forms and tender physical scale. Daytime fairy-tale wonder from enlarged coherent living architecture, contrasting sunlit and shaded spatial rooms, walkable arches, clear water and inhabited connected land. Playful shaping more fantastical than an ordinary botanical garden, still entirely grounded and safe. Consistent warm-white sunny light and airy sky-blue water, luminous fresh limited greens, restrained coral, cobalt, yellow patches in houses and fabric residents. No dark green wash, gold-and-cream global palette, moody darkness, blue glowing night, sparkles, crystal towers, neon lamps or magic icons. Material differentiation: thick soft wood, matte walls, velvety rounded leaf crowns, satin roof paint, clear shallow stream, lightly textured sandy ground. Strong beautiful mature silhouette with distinct asymmetric grown districts; no dense microdetail or symmetric concept-board staging. Wide physical place to enter and explore, not a collection of cute objects.
status: provisional unselected whole-world synthesis, future stages D/E included; not current runtime
